title: Guide new claimants through their first claim

fields.summary: Show new claimants a guided checklist for their first claim, to move Goal #20's activation.
fields.hypothesis: If new claimants see a checklist of the documents to gather before they start, activation rises from 0.31 to 0.36 because they no longer abandon the claim to look for documents.
fields.baseline: 0.31: activation over the weekly cohorts of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, from `aayu measure` snapshot all-20261005T060000Z.sqlite
